title: Dark orbit
purpose: Paid ads and closing shot: the floating instrument in the B1-R4 architectural dark scene, a shallow camera orbit with its shadow rendered in every frame.
notes: 12 degrees of orbit about the shot's own focus point (from 6 degrees before the approved B1-R4 angle to 6 after it); the product and its float never move, so the floor shadow is the scene's own, path-traced per frame. No spin. The middle frame is the approved B1-R4 framing.

reframes.purpose: Vertical composition reference: B2 +15 % (B2_115_R4) with the same orbit.
